{{Youmay|the occupation of security guard|the [[Security Guard/Legends|Security Guard]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]}}
{{Otheruses|guard|more=security officer}}
{{Image}}
'''Security guards''' or '''security officers''' were beings hired to guard certain locations and establishments in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They could also be hired as private security forces. [[Security specialist]]s were guards who had extensive training in close-quarters combat and had special skills and knowledge.<ref name="Threats">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
